input_activity.source: Explicit mean-activity assumption; not sampled workload switching

mean_conductance.source: Explicit uniform cell-code approximation; no conductance measurements

driver_idle_fraction.source: Engineering standby allowance; borrowed 5% scale from New_Architecture!U40, not a measured driver leakage

adc_idle_fraction.source: New_Architecture!U52, applied as a standby allowance to the SAR proxy; not measured leakage

analog_supply_v.source: New_Architecture!O40/O52 amplifier bias formulas; thick-oxide proxy retained at source voltage

frontend_bias_ua.source: New_Architecture!O40 literal current, reused as a conditioning amplifier proxy

reference_bias_mw.source: New_Architecture!Q56 literal 2*0.26 shared bias, used once per core

layout_area_fraction.source: New_Architecture!D97 area margin, treated as a floorplanning allowance

clock_wire_power_fraction.source: Explicit engineering allowance for physical distribution; not a synthesis or layout result

peripheral.boundary: Approximate preloaded-core costs. Source-specific operating points, ideal analog correctness and engineering allowances. No calibrated full-chip PPA.
excluded: Host I/O, Go rules and metadata
Package, pads, ESD and off-chip memory

cacti_build.compiler:
Apple clang version 17.0.0 (clang-1700.0.13.5)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.6.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin

boundaries: CACTI FA cache is a cost proxy: 32-bit key plus valid padded to 36 bits and 32-bit payload. All-match output routing is not characterized.
CACTI external DRAM I/O and MemCAD output are unrelated and excluded.
SAR native22 HP model: 0.85 V technology, 0.4 V read, 360 K; no additional process scaling.
SAR input resistance is an assumed mean from workbook R_on, not measured. Its zero leakage field is unmodeled.
The 9 ns converter model fits within the existing 18 ns service; no schedule change or energy doubling.
These are uncalibrated proxies. Readout accuracy, full-chip layout and common PVT remain unvalidated.

E4.value: Set this to 1 for normal operation. Set to <1 for low power operation

E6.value: Sign is handled by applying negative voltage and separate arrays for positive and negative weights

E15.value: Separate arrays for positive and negative weights

B38.value: FET type 2 area increase due to L increase

N42.value: Integrator energy scaling with active columns

N47.value: Always on energy of all integrators

N48.value: Integrators energy scaling with active columns

N55.value: ADC energy scaling with active columns (pJ)

N58.value: ADC power scaling with active columns (mW)

N70.value: MVMU power scaling with active columns (mW)
